mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.subject_id, t.name, t.paper_type, t.total_max_score, t.auto_scored_max_score, t.remark, t.status, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM exam_paper_template t WHERE t.subject_id = #{subjectId} AND t.status = 'ENABLED' LIMIT 1

SELECT t.id, t.subject_id, t.name, t.paper_type, t.total_max_score, t.auto_scored_max_score, t.remark, t.status, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM exam_paper_template t WHERE t.subject_id = #{subjectId} LIMIT 1

SELECT s.id, s.template_id, s.sitting_no, s.sitting_name, s.total_duration, s.total_max_score, s.auto_scored_max_score, s.sort_no FROM exam_paper_sitting s WHERE s.template_id = #{templateId} ORDER BY s.sitting_no ASC LIMIT 20

SELECT c.id, c.template_id, c.sitting_no, c.section_no, c.section_name, c.section_type, c.question_type, c.question_count, c.per_question_score, c.duration_min, c.duration_max, c.allow_early_submit, c.support_status, c.sort_no FROM exam_paper_section c WHERE c.template_id = #{templateId} ORDER BY c.section_no ASC LIMIT 50
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exam_paper_template (subject_id, name, paper_type, total_max_score, auto_scored_max_score, status) VALUES (#{subjectId}, #{name}, #{paperType}, #{totalMaxScore}, #{autoScoredMaxScore}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE exam_paper_template SET name = #{name}, paper_type = #{paperType}, total_max_score = #{totalMaxScore}, auto_scored_max_score = #{autoScoredMaxScore}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exam_paper_sitting (template_id, sitting_no, sitting_name, total_duration, total_max_score, auto_scored_max_score, sort_no) VALUES (#{templateId}, #{sittingNo}, #{sittingName}, #{totalDuration}, #{totalMaxScore}, #{autoScoredMaxScore}, #{sortNo})

INSERT INTO exam_paper_section (template_id, sitting_no, section_no, section_name, section_type, question_type, question_count, per_question_score, duration_min, duration_max, allow_early_submit, support_status, sort_no) VALUES (#{templateId}, #{sittingNo}, #{sectionNo}, #{sectionName}, #{sectionType}, #{questionType}, #{questionCount}, #{perQuestionScore}, #{durationMin}, #{durationMax}, #{allowEarlySubmit}, #{supportStatus}, #{sortNo})
